usage.callShape: POST https://api.x-router.ai/v1/chat/completions with OpenAI-compatible JSON body {model, messages:[{role,content}], max_tokens?}. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base).
usage.outputShape: body.choices[0].message.content (assistant text); token usage at body.usage; some models also populate body.choices[0].message.reasoning
quirks: Model field MUST be an OpenRouter-style slug 'provider/model' (e.g. minimax/minimax-m3, anthropic/claude-opus-4.8, qwen/qwen3.7-plus) — bare OpenAI names like 'gpt-4o-mini' return a free HTTP 400 INVALID_MODEL with no charge.
List valid models via free GET https://api.x-router.ai/v1/models (300 models, each with id + per-1k-token pricing).
Price 'Varies' = per-model token-based billing; pick a cheap model + small max_tokens to keep cost down (minimax/minimax-m3 was $0.001 for a tiny call).
Reasoning models may put output in message.reasoning and leave message.content null if max_tokens is too small (finish_reason 'length'); raise max_tokens to get content.
usage.guide: Send a standard OpenAI chat-completions POST to https://api.x-router.ai/v1/chat/completions with body {model, messages, max_tokens}. The model MUST be an OpenRouter-style slug (provider/model) — fetch the free GET /v1/models list first if unsure; bare OpenAI names fail with a free 400. Payment is automatic via x402 (USDC on Base), priced per model and token count. Read the assistant reply at body.choices[0].message.content (give enough max_tokens or reasoning models leave content null).
